I answered Tobias in a thread reply in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was **Southgate**.

The source is Priyanka's posts in that channel on 2025-09-03. She said label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day she posted that the incident was resolved and Southgate had cleared the backlog. The channel doesn't give a street address for the depot, and I told him that.

I checked that Tobias is a member of #inc-tansley-carrier-api before reading it. I didn't use search or any channel he can't see.
